hero.p: A strategic Tower Defense featuring placement validation and a modular portal system.

about.title: The ultimate defense against the undead

points.1: In a world devastated by the undead, survival depends on strategy. Zombie Siege Chronicles is an immersive tower defense game where players must protect their shelter from relentless waves.
points.2: Developed in a collaborative environment, the project highlights key contributions to core systemic mechanics, UI architecture, and high-level gameplay logic.
points.3: The design showcases a deep integration between robust C++ backend systems and responsive Blueprint visual feedback to ensure a smooth tactical experience.

points.1: Defensive Arsenal: Deploy modular turrets and barriers. Some defenses, such as barbed wire, deal passive damage while blocking passage.
points.2: Portal Strategy: A two-actor teleportation system that allows the player to instantly reposition across the battlefield.
points.3: Dynamic Waves: Scalable difficulty through round-based stat boosts and the activation of multiple spawn points.
points.4: Survivor Events: Random missions to rescue NPCs, rewarding the player with base health or extra resources.

points.1: Placement Validation: A collision-based system using specialized areas to verify if a defense can be built on a specific surface.
points.2: C++ Portal Logic: Implementation of entry/exit vectors, cooldown timers, and visual state management for the teleportation network.
points.3: Asynchronous Loading: Professional transitions via asynchronous loading screens to manage map assets without frame drops.
points.4: UI Architecture: Complex structure for HUD and Shop, featuring real-time economy updates and modular inventory visualization.

points.1: Asset Standardization: Strict naming conventions and project hierarchy to facilitate collaboration within the development team.
points.2: Hybrid Audio: Dynamic audio mixers for environmental immersion, integrated with positional SFX for combat actions.
points.3: Spline Camera: Cinematic menu sequences using spline-based camera rigs for a dynamic 3D background.
points.4: Collision Optimization: Custom Trace Channels to separate enemy navigation from player interaction.

placement.title: Spatial Placement Validation
placement.desc: A robust system designed to enforce building restrictions by cross-checking item types against area-specific collision volumes.
placement.img_alt: The turret's internal properties to define the turret building rules.
placement.img1_desc: Item Type Definition: A look at the turret's internal properties using a lightweight uint8 variable to define building rules.
placement.img2_desc: Validation Area Setup: The BP_TurretsArea trigger volume using a property selector and custom meshes to define building boundaries.

portals.title: Teleportation System
portals.desc: Technical analysis of the portal mechanics, featuring entry/exit validation, dynamic material states, and cooldown logic.
portals.img1_desc: Portal actor analysis: Features dynamic materials, invisible interaction planes for navigation, and a debug arrow for entry/exit vectors.
portals.img2_desc: Invalid placement state: The portal turns red when attempting to build on the road, where structures are prohibited.
img3_desc: Valid placement state: Successful verification on sidewalks.
The mesh turns blue, providing immediate visual feedback.

menu.title: Hybrid Cinematic Menu
menu.desc: An immersive main menu blending a real-time 3D environment with a complex UI and cinematic camera movements.
menu.img1_desc: Spline Camera Rig: Implementation of a CineCamera attached to a custom spline rail for a smooth cinematic tracking shot.
menu.img2_desc: Interactive Layering: Breakdown of the widget hierarchy showing the hit-test layering system for complex button interactions.

shop.title: Data-Driven Shop System
shop.desc: A modular UI architecture that populates content dynamically by reading from centralized C++ Data Tables.
shop.img1_desc: Item Data Table: The Row Editor where prices, stats, and icons are managed for rapid gameplay balancing.
shop.img2_desc: Shop UI Architecture: The main widget hierarchy using responsive containers to organize dynamically generated entries.
shop.img3_desc: Modular Item Widget: A reusable widget that automatically updates its visuals based on the received row data.

survivors.title: Survivor Rescue System
survivors.desc: A dynamic mission framework that periodically spawns NPCs in need of rescue. It integrates a randomized content system and strategic rewards to diversify the core tower defense gameplay.
survivors.img_alt: The main character, the arrow indicating a survivor and a rescue actor.
img1_desc: Event Configuration: A look at the SavePeopleEvent manager.
It allows designers to easily tune spawning intervals, maximum active NPCs, and specific rewards (Base Health vs. Gold) through custom Blueprint categories.
img2_desc: This architectural choice decouples visual assets from logic, allowing the system to pick a random mesh and animation set for each spawned survivor.
img3_desc: Player Guidance Logic: The rescue actor setup, featuring an integrated pointer widget class.
It provides real-time directional feedback to ensure the player can locate survivors within the environment quickly.
